description:
The `download_artifacts` table in LPBS has no `git_commit_hash` field, making it impossible to trace a published artifact back to its source commit without going through scenario-to-desktop's transient pipeline state. Add `git_commit_hash TEXT` to `download_artifacts`, accept it in the `commit` endpoint, and pass it from scenario-to-desktop's `BuildProvenance` during `CommitArtifact`.

Source: research/desktop-release-control-plane-audit conclusion — Finding 2, Finding 9 gap #6.
name: lpbs-artifact-git-commit-hash
title: Add git_commit_hash field to LPBS download_artifacts table
